Levels.rest_period: Rest period when the subject was silent; can be used as a baseline (source collection description).

nwb_epochs_start_time.Description: Start time of epoch, in seconds

nwb_epochs_stop_time.Description: Stop time of epoch, in seconds

nwb_invalid_times_start_time.Description: Start time of epoch, in seconds

nwb_invalid_times_stop_time.Description: Stop time of epoch, in seconds

nwb_trials_condition.Description: syllable spoken (source column description); consonant-vowel syllable label as hand-annotated in the source. n/a where the source string is empty or the row is not a trial.

nwb_trials_cv_transition_time.Description: time of CV transition in seconds

nwb_trials_speak.Description: if True, subject is speaking. If False, subject is listening

nwb_trials_start_time.Description: Start time of epoch, in seconds

nwb_trials_stop_time.Description: Stop time of epoch, in seconds

trial_type.Description: NWB intervals table name, or cv_transition for explicit point event.

Levels.trials: Syllable production trial from the NWB trials table: onset = hand-marked syllable start, duration = start to stop (source collection: hand-marked annotations of the start, consonant-vowel transition and end of each syllable).
Levels.cv_transition: Zero-duration point event at the hand-marked consonant-to-vowel transition of the trial (NWB trials column cv_transition_time).
Levels.epochs: Interval from the NWB epochs table (rest_period: period when the subject was silent, usable as a baseline, per the source collection description).
Levels.invalid_times: Artifact annotation from the NWB invalid_times table (tag 'ECoG artifact'); the signal is not removed.

source_table.Description: Absolute NWB HDF5 interval table path.

source_row.Description: Zero-based source table row (not table id).

source_onset_column.Description: NWB column used to calculate onset.
